ritual.ariaLabel: E komo i ka hoʻomana - E hoʻouna i kahi inoa i ka Orbital Temple

footer.credits: He hana noʻeau ʻo Orbital Temple na Edson Pavoni , i hana ʻia ma ka laulima ʻana me Pedro Kaled, João Pedro Polito, Victor Baptista, João Victor Alves, André Biagioni, VK, Jonathan Querubina, Guilherme Bullejos, Eduardo Dias, Roberta Savian Rosa, Clara Marques, Daphne Alves, Flavio Vidigal, Andre Holzmeister, Pedro Vidigal, Tatiane Putti, Rafael Fernandes, Bruna Cairo, Gabriela Veiga, Kate Chapman Specter, Marcello Dantas, Anne Valls, Matias Campos Abad, Samuel Levy, Bella Nardini, Leigh Pennington, Nima Gardideh , a me nā kānaka {{count}} a pau i hoʻouna mua i nā inoa i kēia luakini.
